svg.text: K5b CLEANING — no wash system in the cell
Everything that touches food is loose ware: emptied, cold-rinsed within 2 minutes, sent through the port to a dishwasher.
in the cell: 1 rinse seat + splash nozzles only
rinse 0.3 L, 5 s, upward fan nozzle
dishwasher hygiene programme ≥ 70 °C, 10 min (A0 ≈ 60)
≈ 30 L water per 2-person meal before dishes
1 Pig the tube
The square piston wipes the bore
on its way down: ≤ 5 g stays
behind. The pusher clears
the dicer grid the same way.
wiper lip
last of the food into the pot
2 Cold rinse within 2 min
The handler holds the tube mouth-
down over the seat; one upward fan
nozzle, 0.3 L in 5 s. Soil goes to
the strainer basket, water to drain.
strainer basket
drain
upward fan nozzle
3 Through the port to the dishwasher
Rinsed ware waits on bench B; the shutter opens and it leaves for the machine's
bought dishwasher. Clean kits come back the same way.
bench B (deck level)
port shutter
DISHWASHER
(outside the cell)
4 Fixed surfaces: splash zone only
After every cooked meal: fixed nozzles spray deck, walls and column (mains hot water,
venturi detergent); once a day a full wash; the hood fan dries. Nothing hangs over a pot.
die shelf (ledge)
rail box (dry, bands sealed)

g.text: 1/5 The meal is cooked; every vessel and column part is loose ware
2/5 Pig: the piston pushes the tube empty into the pot; the wiper lip leaves ≤ 5 g behind
3/5 Rinse: within 2 minutes the tube is held mouth-down over the seat; 0.3 L cold water in 5 s; soil to the strainer
4/5 Port: the rinsed ware leaves the cell to the machine's dishwasher; fixed surfaces get sprayed by fixed nozzles
5/5 Dry: the hood fan dries the cell; the strainer basket itself leaves through the port after the meal
